title: HUANGCHIHHUNGLeo/claude-real-video
claim: HUANGCHIHHUNGLeo/claude-real-video — Let Claude (or any LLM) actually watch a video — scene-aware, deduplicated frames + transcript, from a URL or local file
why_good: Lets any LLM actually 'watch' video — scene-aware, deduplicated frames — solving the real cost/quality problem of feeding video to models.
value: Usage-based API/SDK for anyone building video-understanding into agents/apps; per-minute processing.
risk: The multimodal labs (Gemini, GPT) natively ingest video and improve fast; a preprocessing layer must stay cheaper/better.

zh.claim: HUANGCHIHHUNGLeo/claude-real-video —— 让 Claude(或任意 LLM)真正 看 视频:场景感知、去重。
zh.why_good: 让任意 LLM 真正 看 视频——场景感知、去重帧——解决 把视频喂给模型 的真实成本/质量问题。
zh.value: 给要把视频理解做进 agent/app 的人做按量 API/SDK:按分钟处理。
zh.risk: 多模态实验室(Gemini、GPT)原生吃视频且进步快;预处理层必须持续更便宜/更好。
